notes.title: Award Odyssey: The Deep Space Exploration as Outstanding Story-Rich Game
notes.notes:
Odyssey is a story driven space adventure audiovisual single/multiplayer experience that you can play on Desktop. Telling a story about human exploration to the unknown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31142121/325236641546da620d03059a8353e0e049111e34.png[/img]

Climate Chance and biodiversity are hot topics nowadays. Odyssey story is all about imagination and human possibilities to create a meaningful future. 
[b]
What inspired us to create this game:[/b]

[b]The space exploration and a imaginary outlook to the future where human beings need to find a planet that could sustain life after our planet couldn't sustain life anymor[/b]

The search continues! Dominate Odyssey as Outstanding Story-Rich Game!

notes.title: Experiencing Space Co-Operation Multiplayer (Manual)
notes.notes:
If you would like to test the Odyssey VR Multiplayer feature, please have a try! It makes the game more challenging and, as tested, more fun.
Here is our manual on how to access the Multiplayer co-op feature in our game:

1) You can either “Join public games” or “Create a new Game” See the image below in the UI lobby.
2) Tell your friends that you want to play.
3) Open the game at the same time as your friends (max 3 players).
4) One of you clicks the “Create a new Game” -button. 
5) Let your friends wait until you get to the end of the hallway and wait until the countdown (10, 9, 8, 7…) is ready.
6) Now tell your friends that you are waiting in the airlock where you can press “Start the Game“.
7) Now your friends can see the game when clicking “Join Public Games“ that is named after the first player.
8) Your friends can now join that game and go to the waiting airlock area.

What do you think about our multiplayer feature process?

Here is a blog post about the game: https://www.touchdowncreations.com/2018/09/23/odyssey-vr-combines-desktop-and-vr/

We have now set up a Discord channel where you can join if you like to and discuss about anything. If you would like, you can join using this link: https://discord.gg/CpNgYH

notes.title: Steam Achievements and feedback
notes.notes:
Hi! we are planning to add Steam Achievements to Odyssey VR : The Deep Space Expedition. Steam Achievements are rewards for completing game objectives or performing pre-determined actions in a game.

When you complete different parts of the game, for example, controlling the cannon, finishing the game or approaching the gate, you can unlock achievements and then you will see your progress during the game and on your Odyssey VR Library!

In addition to that, we get to know how the players have progressed and how far the players go. Have you already completed your Odyssey VR experience? :)

We try to implement achievements (including a complete set of icons) in upcoming weeks.

Lastly, we would like to wish you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! ːsteamhappyː

Lets be in touch in 2018 as well!

Lastly, we would like to wish you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! ːsteamhappyː

Lets be in touch in 2018 as well!
